methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator represents distributed capability-building outside the NoVA corridor, potentially catalyzing peer networks and deep technical fluency in a defense-adjacent region with distinct economic drivers.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership signals grassroots education infrastructure that could generate broad-based fluency beyond elite institutions, distributing capability through community impact rather than concentrating in corporate hubs.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia demonstrates distributed capacity-building in an economically transitioning region, testing whether deep technical skills can take root outside metro concentrations through place-based initiatives.

signals.title: Pittsylvania data center project approved with more investment and jobs than previously announced — as long as tax breaks remain in place
signals.signal_reading: Pittsylvania's $100B data center represents infrastructure concentration dependent on tax incentives, creating jobs but potentially shallow local AI capability—physical presence without deep technical distribution signals widening rather than closing regional gaps.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding skill-building infrastructure signals anxiety about displacement rather than empowerment—shallow exposure to AI tools as workplace mandate rather than deep capability development.
